# Diagram sources

The twelve `.tex` files in `source/` are the versioned diagram sources for both language
editions. They are loaded through the shared `\CaseDiagram` macro and must remain
understandable in monochrome. Rendered pages and intermediate image files are generated
only in temporary build output.
